name: HO-Gaussian
definition: A point-free representation method for multi-camera urban scenes that combines a grid-based volume with the 3DGS pipeline to eliminate dependency on SfM point initialization and enhance rendering in low-texture, sky, and distant areas.
summary: HO-Gaussian is a point-free 3D Gaussian Splatting method that eliminates SfM dependency by learning positions from a grid volume, using Gaussian Directional Encoding to reduce disk space and neural warping for multi-camera consistency.
